data.title: Employer requests onboarding documents before payroll can start
data.summary: Beispiel Software Solutions GmbH welcomes Aisha Okafor, whose first working day is 1 July 2025, and asks her to upload her tax ID, health insurance membership certificate and a copy of her residence permit to the HR portal by 6 June 2025 so payroll and social security registration can proceed.
data.explanation: Your new employer needs three documents (tax ID, health insurance certificate, residence permit copy) uploaded to their HR portal by the stated date so they can register you for payroll and social security in time for your 1 July 2025 start. Upload them via the HR portal as soon as possible. If you miss the deadline, the letter says the employer cannot register you for social security on time, which could delay your payroll setup. If you don't yet have all the documents (e.g. the residence permit), contact HR to explain the situation.

items.title: Upload tax ID, health insurance certificate and residence permit to HR portal
items.action: Upload your tax identification number (Steuer-ID), health insurance membership certificate and a copy of your residence permit to the employer's HR portal.
items.consequence: The employer cannot register you for social security on time without these documents.
items.quote: Please upload your tax identification number (Steuer-ID), your health insurance membership certificate and a copy of your residence permit to the HR portal no later than 6 June 2025.
